title: Sharp Design Frontier for the Rare-Event Finite-Population Log Risk Ratio
banked_reason: Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded, or re-anchor the proposal (rewind D-1.2). Authoritative ceiling6.7<field7.4; sound math, five cited leaves verified, independent terminal audit confirms no bounded repair.
gap_reasons: The frontier concerns the declared factor-two counterfactual-total band and the specified iterated limit, leaving joint growing-cohort/count precision unresolved.
General calibration is established through exhaustive enumeration, while delivered numerical allocation evidence stops at B=2 and supplies no operational assessment beyond those small bands.
The O(B²/N) transfer errors and B_star=2^216 threshold make the analytic certificates insufficient to demonstrate informative finite-cohort performance across moderate bands.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery discharged the endpoint-allocation boundary, certified all-quota calibration, and sharp iterated large-band constant 4 under the declared factor-two finite-population class. Math and decision referees passed with no findings and five cited leaves verified; independent terminal review confirmed the completed package is subfield (6.7), below the field floor (7.4), with no bounded repair. No Lean formalization was launched; improving the joint growing-count/cohort regime, finite-cohort constants, or operational calibration requires new research.
tldr: The structural endpoint-allocation boundary, certified continuous-quota calibration, and proved sharp iterated all-design precision constant characterize the rare finite-population log risk ratio frontier. The analyst-declared two-world sensitivity class \(B\le K_0(Y),K_1(Y)\le2B\) defines a conditional mathematical stress test. The symmetric endpoint-quota law has optimized value \(L^2/4\) for every band and is globally optimal exactly when \(B=1\); an explicit four-quota procedure improves it uniformly over unknown overlap for every \(B\ge2\). Certified arbitrary-precision values and allocation/reconstruction procedures have legal nonempty-arm finite original-record lifts and lower certificates covering every continuous quota. The quota-uniform full-data certificate proves \(\varkappa=4\) and \(C_B\sim C_B^{\mathrm{bal}}\sim4/B\), after the fixed-band even-cohort limit, with first-order attainment by balanced assignment and the total pseudocount decoder. Both observed counts and independently varying unknown totals are retained in the converse. The mathematical claims are discharged in this D0 note; only Lean formalization remains pending. Exact first-band values and the global second-band bracket provide supporting calibration checks. Dette's relative-risk maximin allocation is comparator-only positioning under another experiment and asymptotic efficiency/cost criterion. The conditional result supplies no empirically validated event band, trial-planning recommendation, or deployment claim.
gap: Dette \cite{Dette2004RobustRiskDesigns} supplies a direct relative-risk maximin allocation comparator under independent two-binomial sampling and an asymptotic relative-efficiency/cost criterion. Its interior allocation result does not establish the fixed-labelled-table, full-original-record, all-fair-law minimax converse or the endpoint-allocation if-and-only-if boundary posed here. Hull and Sudijono--Dobriban--Tchetgen Tchetgen solve full-cube bounded-ATE problems; their dense target-preserving transformations do not preserve the two positive rare-total bands and logratio. Exact binary RR interval inversion is already available. These distinct results leave the combined structural boundary, certified continuous-quota calibration, and sharp iterated all-design constant unresolved by the cited sources; no universal absence claim is made.
fill: Theorems 4, 5, and 7 carry the mathematical contribution: the exact endpoint-allocation boundary with an evaluated overlap-uniform exit margin, certified all-continuous-quota values and attaining procedures with finite original-record lifts, and the evaluated sharp iterated constant against every fair design and original-record estimator. The first-band identities and second-band global bracket are calibration corollaries and verification evidence for this frontier. Generic orbit reduction, saddle duality, a bare optimization program, and an ordinary delta upper are supporting machinery. All calibration is conditional on the analyst-declared two-world sensitivity class; it supplies no empirically validated event band, trial-planning recommendation, or deployment claim.
